# PlatformManager

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Platform.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Platform.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Platform/PlatformManager.cs#L22)

Owns the platform session: build settings, incoming platform data, parameters,
the max game time budget and the outgoing reports.

What a report contains is not decided here - see [`PlatformReport`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/PlatformReport). This
module collects what the app contributed, wraps it in the platform's envelope and hands
it to [`ReportQueue`](/api/vrframework-platform-runtime/ReportQueue), which delivers one report at a time.

```csharp
public class PlatformManager : VRModule, IPlatformService
```

### BuildEnvelope(string, int) {#buildenvelope-string-int32}

Wraps a report body in the envelope the platform reads.

"reportData" is a JSON *string* holding the report, not a nested object. That is
what the platform parses, so the body is escaped into a literal here.

### ContributeSessionValues() {#contributesessionvalues}

What the framework itself puts into every report. Override to report the session
differently - these are ordinary report values, so an app can just as well replace one
with [`SetValue(string, object)`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/PlatformReport#setvalue-string-object) or drop it with

### SendReport() {#sendreport}

Collects everything contributed so far and queues it for the platform. Safe to call
mid-session as often as an app likes: each call is a report of its own, and the queue
sends them one at a time in the order they were made.

```csharp
public void SendReport()
```
